## When to use

Use this skill whenever you are working with @mastra/server to obtain the domain-specific knowledge.

## How to use

Read the individual reference documents for detailed explanations and code examples.

### Docs

- [Resumable streams](references/docs-agents-resumable-streams.md) - Publish agent runs on a stream topic so clients can reconnect, other readers can follow a run with observe(), and any reader can stop it.
- [A2A (Agent-to-Agent)](references/docs-connections-a2a.md) - Expose Mastra agents through the Agent-to-Agent protocol and consume remote A2A agents as subagents or call them directly with the client SDK.
- [MCP authentication and authorization](references/docs-guides-mcp-authentication-authorization.md) - Choose credentials for MCP connections, protect a Mastra MCP server, and separate delegated access from tool and data permissions.
- [Knowledge](references/docs-knowledge-overview.md) - Give agents shared pages and notes they search, read and write, with access decided by your configuration rather than by the model.
- [Custom adapters](references/docs-server-custom-adapters.md) - Implement a custom Mastra server adapter for unsupported web frameworks by mapping routes, middleware, request parameters, responses, and streams.
- [Custom API routes](references/docs-server-custom-api-routes.md) - Add custom HTTP endpoints to a Mastra server with schema validation, middleware, authentication, OpenAPI documentation, and control over disconnect behavior.
- [Built-in MCP server](references/docs-server-mcp.md) - Let MCP clients such as Claude Code, Cursor, and the MCP Inspector call your agents, workflows, and tools through the built-in /api/mcp endpoint, with the same auth, RBAC, and FGA as the HTTP API.
- [Middleware](references/docs-server-middleware.md) - Add Mastra server middleware for authentication, authorization, CORS, request logging, route blocking, and request-specific context injection.
- [Server Adapters](references/docs-server-server-adapters.md) - Run Mastra with Elysia, Express, Fastify, Hono, Koa, NestJS, Next.js, or TanStack Start server adapters and control initialization, middleware, routes, prefixes, and OpenAPI.
- [Knowledge](references/docs-studio-knowledge.md) - Browse the Knowledge instances registered on your Mastra server from Studio, as a page tree and a graph.

### Reference

- [Reference: Query traces and spans](references/reference-observability-tracing-advanced-queries.md) - Find, count, and measure completed traces and spans with structured predicates. List matching traces or spans, aggregate them into grouped measures, paginate, poll, and discover query fields.
- [Reference: Built-in MCP tools](references/reference-server-builtin-mcp-tools.md) - Every tool the built-in MCP server at /api/mcp can serve, with its arguments, the HTTP route it calls, and the permission that route needs.
- [Reference: createRoute()](references/reference-server-create-route.md) - Use createRoute() to define type-safe Mastra server routes with Zod validation for requests and responses, plus handler context and OpenAPI metadata.
- [Reference: dispatchRoute()](references/reference-server-dispatch-route.md) - Use dispatchRoute() to run any Mastra server route in-process with the authorization, validation, and error responses an HTTP request to it would get.
- [Reference: invokeRoute()](references/reference-server-invoke-route.md) - Use invokeRoute() to run a Mastra server route in-process as the calling user, with the same validation, permission, and authorization checks as its HTTP endpoint.
- [Reference: MastraServer](references/reference-server-mastra-server.md) - The MastraServer abstract class is the base for all server adapters. Extend this class to create adapters for frameworks other than Hono or Express.
- [Reference: Server routes](references/reference-server-routes.md) - Server adapters register these routes when you call server.init(). All routes are prefixed with the prefix option if configured.


Read [assets/SOURCE_MAP.json](assets/SOURCE_MAP.json) for source code references.
